source.author: verg
source.text: sic Turno, quacumque viam virtute petivit, successum dea dira negat.
source.text_original: sic Turno, quacumque viam virtute petivit, / successum dea dira negat.
source.text_english: Thus, whenever Turnus sought a path by his valor, the dreadful goddess denied him success.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Accepere deae celerique per aethera lapsu diversas petiere vias.
reuse.text_original: ' / Accepere deae celerique per aethera lapsu / diversas petiere vias.
reuse.text_english: The goddesses received him and, with swift glide through the ether, sought different paths.
